objective.text: Render a mailable to check its content separately from fake dispatch assertions.

difficulty.rationale: Validate the user-visible template rather than only the intent to send a mailable class.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A dispatch test using Mail::fake() passes, but a broken Blade variable makes the receipt body fail when rendered. Which additional test exercises the mailable’s HTML content without sending real mail?

options.rationale: Queueability says nothing about whether the HTML view renders correctly.
options.misconception: Queueability says nothing about whether the HTML view renders correctly.

options.text: Assert the mailable was queued exactly once under the fake.
options.rationale: Queue count does not compile or inspect the body template.
options.misconception: Queue count does not compile or inspect the body template.

options.text: Construct the mailable with fixture data and call assertSeeInHtml on expected rendered text.
options.rationale: The content assertion renders the mailable and checks its HTML, exposing template/data problems while avoiding transport delivery.

options.text: Assert the configured SMTP host string is nonempty.
options.rationale: Transport configuration does not validate the template or its supplied data.
options.misconception: Transport configuration does not validate the template or its supplied data.
